name: Katalin Horák — additional son János (b. 1844)
researcher_question: Did Katalin Horák and her husband István Banyári of Kľak, Nová Baňa, Slovakia have a son named János, baptized 1 September 1844?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 20, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved: false match, no findable substitute. The hint names a different wife (Káti Liskovics, not Katalin Horák); 'Banyári' is common enough in this parish that the tree's own data already shows an unrelated same-named man erroneously merged in.
